experiences.position: Director of Business Development and Partnerships

Sphere Partners is a strategic technology partner offering consulting services, cutting-edge software development, expert engineering teams on-demand and enterprise platform implementations such as Monday.com, Netsuite, Salesforce, Google Cloud and Snowflake for companies seeking to transform in a demanding digital world. 

With a global team of business and technology consultants, solution creators, and engineers, Sphere delivers strategy, design, and software development to help organizations solve their technology challenges and improve productivity, enhance the user experience, and maximize growth.

With headquarters in Chicago and regional offices in London, Miami, and Eastern Europe, Sphere Sphere Partners has built innovative software solutions since 2005 for industry leaders ranging from start-ups to Fortune 100 by transforming initial visions into effective technological solutions. Clients include:  BuzzFeed, Tumblr, ING Bank, Subway, Beachbody, Groupon, Enova, Nokia, Morningstar, Sears, Gett, Hub Group, Sittercity, Springleaf, and Eligo Energy. Our consulting and development services include:  Agile Mobile & Web Applications, DevOps Engineering, Enterprise Platforms Service & Support, Solution Architecture, Team Augmentation, Cloud Solutions, Advanced Analytics, Data Visualization, and UX/UI Design.
